caption: The drawing depicts a large, ornate urn with a lid, standing on a square pedestal base. The urn is rendered in grayscale pencil or ink, with detailed shading to indicate its metallic surface and rounded form. Decorative patterns encircle the upper rim and base of the urn, and there is an oval medallion with script initials on its front, surrounded by intricate floral and ribbon engravings. In the upper left corner, there is a circular detail showing an enlarged view of the monogram within the medallion. To the right of the urn are two additional sketches: one is a simple outline of the entire urn, shown in profile with dimensions, and the other is a standalone cluster of flowers resembling the floral decoration on the urn. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with the artist’s name "Hester Batty" written in the lower left corner.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl
